request.query: polynomial determinant coefficient height bound factorial product degree Hasse derivative

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : Semiring R] → ℕ → Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R

items.name: Polynomial.iterate_derivative_eq_factorial_smul_sum
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (k : ℕ),
  (⇑Polynomial.derivative)^[k] p =
    k.factorial •
      ∑ x ∈ ((⇑Polynomial.derivative)^[k] p).support,
        Polynomial.C ((x + k).choose k • p.coeff (x + k)) * Polynomial.X ^ x

items.name: Polynomial.iterate_derivative_prod_X_sub_C
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {k : ℕ} {S : Finset R},
  k ≤ S.card →
    (⇑Polynomial.derivative)^[k] (∏ a ∈ S, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a)) =
      ↑k.factorial * ∑ T ∈ Finset.powersetCard (S.card - k) S, ∏ a ∈ T, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a)

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_hasseDeriv_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) p).natDegree ≤ p.natDegree - n

items.name: Polynomial.factorial_smul_hasseDeriv
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ), ⇑(k.factorial • Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) = (⇑Polynomial.derivative)^[k]
